name: Cindy Gainsborough
source: Cindy is Wade’s girlfriend. They met in college and have been dating for about three years. Cindy is a beautiful, charming and cheerful girl, always full of energy, but she has a temper and always wants things to go her way, and she’s used to getting what she wants.
